name: Generic Bearer session token leaked via a tool response (CVE-2026-25650 shape, generalized)
notes: TODOS #53. CVE-2026-25650 (smn2gnt/MCP-Salesforce get_record): an unchecked object_name argument reaches getattr(sf_client.sf, object_name); object_name="headers" returns the live client's own Authorization: Bearer <session token> header dict verbatim in the tool response text. No vendor-specific prefix, so this is a lower-confidence signature distinct from credential-egress-in-response's prefix-anchored patterns. Token is a synthetic, pattern-shaped value generalized to a non-Salesforce session-token shape (underscore + hex) rather than Salesforce's own `<org-id>!<signature>` format — a pre-merge adversarial review found widening the character class to match that literal `!`-bearing format false-positived on real benign text (webpack loader chaining, PEP-440 version strings, Salesforce's own docs explaining the format). See the benign fixture generic-bearer-prose-and-short-token.json for the FP regressions, and TODOS #53 for the accepted gap (the CVE's own literal PoC token is no longer matched).
